result.description: Developer platform for hosting Git repositories, collaborating on code, issues/PRs, CI (Actions) and software delivery.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 web flow for OAuth Apps and GitHub Apps (user access tokens); personal access tokens (classic and fine-grained); GitHub App installation tokens via JWT signed with app private key.
result.access_detail: Free account gives full API access. OAuth Apps and GitHub Apps are self-registered in developer settings with no GitHub review. Orgs may restrict third-party OAuth app access (org owner approval to grant access to org data), but that is per-org, not a gate for the developer.
result.api_notes: REST API covers hundreds of endpoints (repos, issues, PRs, actions, orgs, users, checks, packages, etc.); GraphQL v4 API offers precise data fetching. Rate limits apply; webhooks supported.

evidence.quote: You can also create an OAuth token with an OAuth app to access the REST API.
You can create a personal access token, generate a token with a GitHub App
GitHub offers free and paid plans for storing and collaborating on code.
If your GitHub App is **public**, other accounts can also install it.
You can use GitHub's API to build scripts and applications that automate processes
The GitHub GraphQL API offers flexibility and the ability to define precisely the data you want to fetch.
The GitHub MCP Server connects AI tools directly to GitHub's platform.
GitHub is a platform that supports your entire software development process
